notes.title: V1.3.5 - Or rather just a fix for 1.3.4
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This isn't really a new version, but the changes are noticeable so I put it under 1.3.5
Following the last two posts on community, I discovered an issue with november's update.
When [u]loading a save to the Battle prep screen[/u] (where you see the map and select your formation) the game would load the initial map data, instead of the updated one.

If you finish the map in one go, you'll never notice it, and in most chapters in normal or easy, it didn't cause any issue, but there were several chapters where some enemy units would just [u]disappear on reload[/u], even though they were there when you saved.
The main chapters affected where the following :
-Ch6 The Legion : Injury wasn't enable on reload, so if one of your character died, they really died (they're not supposed to die in this chapter, even on normal/hard)
-Ch8x Summoning : most enemies didn't appear on reload
-Ch9 White dragon : Aliz and her riders didn't appear on reload
-Ch10 The Dark Howl : the boss didn't appear on reload (and softlock the game since his defeat is the victory condition)
-Ch11 White walls : depending on choices, enemy affiliation could revert to enemy on reload (instead of neutral or ally)
-Ch14 Sisters : Alicia didn't appear no reload
-Ch19 A place we call home : the boss didn't appear on reload (also softlock since its defeat is the victory condition)
-Ch20 Invidia : most enemies didn't appear on reload
-QA1 Little Shadows : injury wasn't enable on reload for a certain character, softlocking the game.

Also, if you played in [b]Hard [/b]mode, a reload would remove enemy skills and on [b]randomized[/b], the enemy randomization.

Long story short, save in the battle prep screen save player data (your trade, position etc) but use the initial map data, and it then loads the opening events. V1.3.4 skipped the opening events on reload, so if some changes are made in the opening events (like making an enemy unit appear...), you see the point.

I disabled the code allowing for this auto event skip and put a manual skip on all the story parts, so normally, the issue is resolved, but in your next load of a battle prep screen, the opening event will be read again. It will only happen once, after that all the subsequent saves in battle screen will skip the story and keep the data intact.
So you can totally load a battle prep save without these issues now, the opening scenes will play again and you won't have any issues (you can fast forward with X or skip with right click/space, won't cause any issues - do the choices though, if any).

I'm really sorry for the inconvenience it might have caused: if you notice any issue with the game please keep posting those in the community. While the game is stable, I can totally break it involuntarily while doing a QoL update, as we just saw ^^

I'm still working on new things, hope I can post a more content-oriented update next!

With best witches,

notes.title: Esperia V1.3.4 - Skip and save changes, and some stuff
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
This update has been delayed quite a bit, so it will have more content than the usual minor update, we're jumping straight to 1.3.4.

[b]Skip function[/b]

-In order to avoid skipping scenes involuntarily (yes, I've read that one negative review), a confirmation windows has been added when you try to skip the story. This will prevent players misclicking on the space bar and missing a part of the story. It also applies to battles, note that "X" is also still useful to fast forward as well without ocnfirmation (and smoother in battle scenes).
-The opening scenes are no longer automatically read when you load a save from the battle preparation screen. Since a skip confirmation windows has been added, it would have been very tedious to try to skip the opening scenes after being defeated in a map… It also didn't make much sense that the opening scenes would be read again after saving in the battle preparation screen anyway.

[b]Save/Load menu[/b]

-The save and load menu have been redesigned, the game now displays 7 saves at once instead of 5, and it's not just put in front of the map but on a dedicated page.
-The save thumbnail has been changed : when saving inside the map there isn't any change, but when saving at the end of a chapter or in the base, the save thumbnail will display an image and a short summary of previous events. This will prevent 'spoiling' the next map when saving at the end of a chapter, and avoid players feeling lost if they take up the game after a long time. This isn't set up on your current save, but will be done once you save again at the end of a chapter or in the base.

[b]Art[/b]

-We added two new character arts for Maya and Kayle. If you don't know who they are I... can't really blame you^^. Maya and Kayle are the two arena fighters you can recruit in chapter 3 and they have an important role in Alex & Sally character quest. 
-The 'tavern' in chapter 5 now has a dedicated background art. It was bothering me to see them talk in the street lol, and a tavern is a useful background to have.

[b]Bugs[/b]

-The siege towers on Chapter 18 can finally move again! There was an issue with their movement previously, but it's fixed now and you can now try and launch on assault on the walls directly.

[b]Extra[/b]

-New glossary entries have been added for Vortigern, Ector, Urien, Sirius and Darian.
-Minor graphical changes in Ch4 intro scene 
-Minor corrections in some dialogs 
-Game is launchable without Steam client on. This has been my fight for the past two months and the reason this update is so late. Not sure if any of you noticed, but V1.3.2 was preventing the game from launching if Steam client wasn't on (V1.3.1 and before didn't). Long story short, this was caused by an SRPG Studio update (the game software) adapting to a Steamworks update (Steam build tool). I can't really blame the engine for keeping up with Steam updates, and I get why Steam does that, but I'm not a fan. So we're back to normal launch now and achievements still work.

Thank you for reading! As always if you liked the game, don't hesitate to leave a review!

PS: Relationships events are on their way for Helen and Melvis!

Hi everyone!

I was quite busy these past few weeks, sorry for the lack of news. This is a minor update correcting some bugs, I'm working on some more important improvements - and other 'big' things - but for now you'll have to do with this!

-Art
The boss character in Ch2 finally has a proper art. It will be updated in the demo soon as well.

-Gameplay

Fixes

With best witches,

notes.title: ESPERIA V1.3 - 1-year anniversary, New Battle UI and Transport
notes.content:
[h2][b]Version 1.3[/b][/h2]

It's already been one year since the launch of Esperia ~ Uprising of the Scarlet Witch ~!
Version 1.3 of the game is available today, it's a major update that brings a lot of changes:

[b]New Battle UI[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36087812/4db83cddfed4a9cef7c7df4be8ea043b4ebeca37.png[/img]
Esperia has a new and improved Battle UI!
-Now all data is displayed on the bottom of the screen, with a way to compare them faster. 
-Player and enemy units in battle have their starting position swapped: player/ally unit start on the left and enemies on the right.
-Battle UI has a different color depending on the unit affiliation.
-When a unit is defeated in battle, the "Face" image will fade away. Enemy's faces are not longer reversed.
-A "Miss" message has been added when a unit successfully avoids an attack.
-Fullscreen battles (with real battle scaling on) have a different ratio and prevent images and UI to be enlarged horizontally.

[b]Critical cut-in[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36087812/746a1cab910399df0409770ffc214fb19a47e0b1.png[/img]
-Each player unit and main ally/enemy unit has a cut-in animation displayed during critical attacks! The mobs units don't have one yet, but maybe we will put it in the future (the lone soldier doing a 2% critical deserves his moment of glory !)

[b]Changes to preparatory screen[/b]

-Checking the map and rearranging unit position was possible through a right click on the Battle Prep Screen. This has been disabled and replace by a dedicated command "Formation".
The same "Formation" command inside the Manage menu has been removed, as it wasn't working properly. Deployment menu has been renamed "Select Units".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36087812/ccda589725ca8de3f14c2c1f2183b51b4ff6a15c.png[/img]
[b]Other graphic changes[/b]

-Chapter titles have new illustration and animation.
-Dragon bosses have a new battle sprite and animations.
-New illustration for Ector.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36087812/41d21e4c36c67b4989b09172c6283e7ff7596b51.png[/img]
[b]Gameplay changes[/b]

-A new command "Transport" has been added in the game. Mounted units (horseback or flying) can now carry other units if they are not armored or mounted themselves. Using the command leaves the mounted unit with a remaining movement and no action, but upon releasing on another turn, the transported unit can act immediately.
This will allow for new strategies in various maps, especially siege ones, and increase the versatility of horseback and normal units. 
Note that Diana cannot be transported by dragons, nor Liliane by horses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36087812/21997d15ba020481147af7697398a7e568bdd73e.png[/img]
-Grim's initial stats in Ch8 have been increased. The previous stats distribution was actually inferior to his lv8 version in Ch4x, this should make him more useful as soon as he joins.
-Ector's class has been changed to Assassin, his skills and stats have been adjusted accordingly.

[b]Other Fixes[/b]

-Chapter 13's name has been changed, it is now called "Out of the Cage" in place of "Rescue Mission". First, because "Rescue Mission" was kinda lame, and second because "Out of the Cage" has actually a triple meaning in this chapter. I hope you will notice what it refers too.
-Lvl B relationship between Diana and Nina now can only be unlocked after the end of Chapter 12, as it mentions events from that chapter
-Mutism's description has been corrected: it doesn't have the ability to cancel items (it was the case before 1.2)
-Astrid wasn't learning her class skill at level 10, she now has it back.
-Nina's Druid map sprite was reverting to that of a normal druid after taking an action
-Allied units in chapter 12 only had skills in Hard mode, but not in Normal or Easy.
-Allied units in chapter 18 didn't have any skills, regardless of difficulty
-On chapter 15x the defeat condition wasn't triggering properly. The battle background was also misplaced.
-Several minor bugs across the game have been solved in Hard mode, mainly skills given to units that hadn't reached the appropriate level (or the opposite)
-A Description has been added to Siege Towers in Chapter 18

Esperia will also be on a 40% reduction for a bit less than 48h to celebrate the 1-year anniversary! If you were still hesitant or want to recommend it to your friends, there is no better time!

Several important announcements are in the work for the following weeks and months, stay tuned, and thank you to everyone who kickstarted and bought the game directly, you're the ones making this story possible!

With best witches,

notes.title: ESPERIA V1.2 - New Game Mode (Randomized) & New UI
notes.content:
[h2][b]Version 1.2 is here! [/b][/h2]

Be ready because there are a lot of things to cover! 
For old players, please stick to the end as the last part might be important for you!

[b]New Difficulty mode - Randomized[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36087812/d1d262b62de4dc46fc543f00969ee6129362a3ce.png[/img]

A new difficulty mode has been introduced, if you play a new game in this difficulty, all the enemies will have a random class, equipment and skills (except for key characters). This means you can face a dragon while trying to rout some bandits, or discover that the head of the group of stealthy assassin suddenly became an armored knight with the Seduction skill. 

This mode, by definition, isn't really balanced, but I find it quite fun to play! It's probably a good option if you want to replay the game (or who knows, even stream it!).

If it's well received, we may add a mode randomizing the player units as well in the future.

[b]UI and Graphic changes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36087812/c37b6bd2f4e20a7d680d647384fa77d1a9f06e42.png[/img]

[u]New Unit Menu and Deploy menu[/u]
-The old menu that was taking the entire screen has been replaced by a menu displayed on the two sides of the screen. It's more beautiful, and more practical. Usable weapons and the bonus from relationships are also all visible in the menu, you don't need to switch pages to see them.
-These changes apply to deploy menu as well, the menu now includes Battle stats and Relations (absent before)
-Character portraits have been replaced by full illustrations on the menus.

[u]New Battle preview[/u]
-We have a new battle preview that is displayed on the side of the screen to free the map. It also includes skills and current states.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36087812/d37a3d45ffd8e9831d835396269c8bc3321ce6b5.png[/img]

[u]New character arts[/u]
-New art for Governor Melphis and the basic Mediana/Rebel Soldiers. They have been implemented in the story.
-New 'shadow' arts have been assigned to all units on the map, to fill the new menus.

[u]Map changes[/u]
-The famous black bars have been replaced by a background. I hope you like it.
-Unit menu and terrain information is now fixed outside of the map.
-Units area of attack don't go outside of the battle window anymore.

[b]Gameplay changes[/b]

[u]Weapon ranks[/u]
-The weapon rank system [u]has been removed[/u].
This was a hard choice, but I noticed the weapon rank system was slowing down the game a bit (by roughly half a second on enemy phase, usually not noticable but visible on map with high number of enemies) and it also had a very small impact on the gameplay, actually. The use of powerful item is already controlled by durability, and rare/high rank equipment are introduced gradually as the story progresses anyway so there is no real need to add another layer of control here. 
It could also be a bit frustrating with some unit starting at low rank like Sara with E-rank in magic or Elphin with E-rank in charms.
The colors on weapon icon are still there, as they are a good way to judge the rarity/power of a weapon.
Items that boost weapon ranks are not sold anymore, if you have one already, it has been changed to an item that gives you a skill linked to that weapon type instead.

[u]Necromancy[/u]
-Nina's Necromancy skill has been reworked, it works on all maps now, and you can choose where you deploy the skeleton around her. 

[u]Steal[/u]
-Objects stolen by the enemies can now be taken back by defeating them
-Artifacts cannot be stolen anymore! This allowed for a big gold exploit where you could steal all the artifacts the enemies had and sell them.
-A new command « Steal Gold » has been introduced for Marie. She needs to be equipped with the Steal skill and it can be used two times per map. Also, the player gets gold in the base on Chapter 10 and 17 now, and initial amount has been increased by 500.
-Steal is not dependent on speed anymore (if a thief was faster than Marie he could steal an object and she was unable to take it back, for instance. Now she can).  

[b]Other fixes[/b]
-Corrected performance issues in Ch11-11x and 18. Chapter 11 was especially bad, I'm surprised no one reported it. It took over 3 seconds to load enemy's movements (partly because of weapon ranks, the neutral faction, the sheer number of enemies and calculating enemy's AoE magic). It's a bit over 1 second now.
-Artifacts are now different from items, that means the 'Silence' state (from the 'Mutism' orb magic) will only prevents magic and artifacts use (it prevented item use before). 
-A bug where two « Artifacts » command appear has been solved.

As always if you see any bug or weird behaviour from the game, don't hesitate to post it in the community! I would be glad if you can leave a review on the store too! The demo will be updated later today to match all these changes.

With best witches,

PS: [b]FOR OLD PLAYERS (before June) [/b]: 
[u]If you have a save that was done inside of a map (ex: at turn 10, turn 5 etc...)[/u] the map is already loaded with old parameters. This means that the new UI cannot be put outside of map boundaries during this chapter. 
Since this major update change the Unit menu, you will be unable to see detailed battle stats and items when you right click on a unit on said map (they're still accessible via item menu, however. Battle preview is fine, too). 
[u]It only last during this map[/u], but it can be inconvenient, so if you want, you have the possibility to switch to the old UI by using what Steam call a game branch, to finish the chapter, and then come back to the main branch. I will put an article in the community to explain this, you can then switch back to the new version whenever you want by changing branch again. 
This concerns all the saves done during a map prior to May 31st. Normal saves at the base, end of chapters or deploy menu are not concerned.

notes.title: Esperia V1.1.9 -Map changes in preparation for V1.2
notes.content:
Hello!

This update main purpose is changing map sizes in preparation for the next main update, here are the main changes :
-The 'size' of all maps has been changed, [b]however[/b], the game area itself didn't, which means you probably won't notice the difference, except on very big maps that now have 'black bars' on their left and right, too. 
The reason for this change is because all that empty space on each side of most maps was unused. Now, the black parts on each side will welcome the terrain description, as well as part of the menu and objective screen, freeing the view of the current map.
-None of these changes apply to maps already loaded. Basically, if you saved *during* a map, that map won't be changed and you still have the useless black bars that can't welcome any UI (this is linked to the 'important' note below).
-While I was at it, I changed Ch3 and 4 maps a bit. The game area itself didn't change much, so it's played almost the exact same but there was a lot of unused space in both of them. I will update the demo later this week to match these changes. I also recolored the red carpets in several chapters

IMPORTANT - There will be a displaying issue on your old saves if you saved during a map or in the "preparatory" screen. I couldn't fix that (yet).
Don't panic, once you load everything is normal and it will disappear if you just save again. It's just that the save system kept the previous coordinates and tries to apply them to the 'new' map. So you will see the usual red and blue dots in weird positions, but nothing has changed on your save, since it will either load the 'old' map with old coordinates (saved at turn X) or in case of a save in the preparatory screen, load the new map during the opening event.

Other fixes:
-Minor fixes in script in several parts of the game.
-Astrid and Sara relationship also triggered the Elphin-Astrid relation bonus (on Elphin's side).
-A chest wasn't marked as open in Close Bonds II, even after being opened
-Helen's info was wrongly displayed in Extra even if the player hadn't met her.

-Unit markers have been added on the map. When you select one of your units to move, a small icon will appear on top of others units if :
*You can talk to this unit with this character (you don't need to put yout unit right next to it to see)
*You have a relationship with this unit (to help position your units and benefit from the bonus)
*The enemy unit has a weapon effective against your unit or a high critical rate (at least 20%)
-All animations should be smoother now, as they have more frames. I tested all classes/types but if you notice something odd, please write about it in the bug section.
-The "Info" command on base has been removed as it wasn't used.

Fixes :
-Some animations were glitching after an indirect attack (general and mercenary). Paladin indirect attack has been reworked.
-The last image was still unlocked even after reaching the end of the game.
-Valmer and the Dark Howl appeared too close to the player on Chapter 5. Especially Valmer. This is a bug as their original position was changed when the map was made bigger.

This week, Esperia is 20% off to celebrate the two-months since launch! It's a good time if one of your friend wants to try it!

notes.title: Esperia V1.1.6 - Small fixes and graphic changes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This update fixes a couple of bugs and bring minor graphic changes :

Fixes :

Graphic:

notes.title: Esperia V1.1.5 - Balancing, small fixes and mouse control?
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this update aims at fixing some issues and change balancing, please read it to the end!

Balancing :
-We added swords and spears effective against armor units: "rapier" and "shock lance". Generals were especially hard to kill with full hp, so this should level up the field a bit. We also added a chest containing a rapier in the Governor house in Ch4 that will help against the boss in Ch5.
-The 4th character quest with Disguised Truth has been rebalanced, with a small increase in Elphin's tome durability, reinforcements have D instead of C rank weapons and the boss B instead of A. Rewards for defeating him is now a A-rank charm.

Fixes :
-The "Berserk" class skill was giving a bonus of +8 in STR/SKL/SPD instead of +4! It was giving the right +4 bonus but triggered twice... How were you guys even dealing with enemy berserkers in hard mode...?
-On Chapter 11(a), two villages had the same events (dialogs and items)
-On Chapter 10, some units had a lv10 class skill despite not being lvl 10 and reinforcement didn't have it despite being lv10.
-We extended ch2 map by 1 tile so that the mouse icon isn't covered anymore when trying to save/load.
-Not really a fix, but Nina in Necromancer finally has a better personal sprite and her Occultist motion has slightly change as well to welcome Alice. I'll probably make it better in the future.

New Control :
-We added a new control called "Details" in the game control option. It is by default linked to "shift" key. This allows you to read the extra content on some support magic where it's written 1/3 (for instance, Heresy or Salamander)

Mouse use on Fullscreen :
-This is an issue I still didn't solve entirely, you will see no change in the default version, however, I put a "test" version in a branch of the game that has this functionality. 
If you do a right click on the game in your library and go to Properties, you can click on "Beta" and opt-in in a test version. 
[u]This won't affect your saves[/u], you can switch from default to beta when you want, this beta version has the mouse control in Fullscreen. 
It works fine on my end, but it uses hardware instead of software to call the fullscreen, so I didn't put it in the normal branch yet as it might cause conflict with some hardwares (not to mention Steam Deck, can't try it there either...). I would be glad if some of you (especially those who wanted mouse control ^^) could give it a try and report in the community tab. If there is no issue, I will probably push it in the default branch afterwards.

Thank you for reading, hope you keep enjoying the game and as always, think about leaving a review!

notes.title: Esperia ~Uprising of the Scarlet Witch~ will be released on March 1st, 2023!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the release of Esperia ~ Uprising of the Scarlet Witch ~ on March 1st, 2023!

Esperia is a hybrid game combining turn-based tactical rpg with a deep visual novel narrative. 
The game takes place in a heroic fantasy setting inspired by Arthurian myths and follows the journey of Diana Pendragon, second princess of Mediana, as she flees her castle after being accused of high treason and use of witchcraft. 
Meet new allies and gather an army able to stand up to the kingdom, make the right choices both in and out of the battlefield to reclaim Diana's title and uncover the secrets of her kingdom and her family.

After four years of development, Esperia will be launched on Wednesday 1st March, ten weeks from now! 

This is what you can expect from the game :
[list]
[*]More than 20 hours of playtime (unless you RTA the story and play on easy!)
[*]Over 20 playable characters with their own story and development
[*]A rich story with original music, character and event art (main story with choices is 250k words)
[*]Relationship system between your characters: pair them up to get new skills, stories and endings!
[*]Simple mechanics and growing difficulty for new players, challenging hard modes for veterans.
[*]Customization of your characters through additional parameters points and skill management.
[*]Permadeath on normal and higher modes, your units have one life!
[/list]

We are excited to bring a new srpg and visual novel project to life and we hope you will all enjoy building your own army and play through the story of Diana and the Pendragons.

[previewyoutube=8BAv-Gr5GRA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Esperia ~ Uprising of the Scarlet Witch ~ Demo available!
notes.content:
Esperia ~ Uprising of the Scarlet Witch ~ is taking part in the Steam Autumn Festival!

On this occasion, we released our demo and you can play through the first five chapters of the game (2 hours of content) and use seven of the playable characters. For newcomers, here is the trailer of the game!

[previewyoutube=3UVZEl8nsug;full][/previewyoutube]

Esperia is an hybrid game that combines turn-based tactical RPG battles with a visual novel narrative. 
In the story you lead Diana, the second princess of Mediana as she's forced to flee her castle with her most loyal knight. Framed as a witch and a traitor, accused of plotting against the Crown, she will fight to reclaim her title and discover what's happening in the country, even if it means going up against her own family.

This is a story of war, bonds and betrayal. Each playable character has their own story and objectives, and they can develop affection toward one another, ultimately altering their ending. If one of them were to be defeated in battle, they will likely die in the story as well, so choose your moves carefully!

We hope you will enjoy playing the demo, we're open to feedback if you want to share your experience, ask questions or suggest some improvements! You can comment here or if possible use the discussion / community tabs of the game for that!

With best witches,

Prismalice
